text:
Maya: Heads-up — re: next quarter roadmap we need a concrete proposal for per-route quota fields and token accounting to share with sales/legal. Customers keep asking about predictable bills when they use function calls + embeddings in the same request.

Alex: Agreed. We should nail the minimal API schema for launch today. Thinking: per-route limit + per-account limit + burst credits. Also explicit fields for what we bill (input vs output tokens, tool call tokens, embeddings).

Priya: +1. For launch let's avoid fancy shapes. MVP idea: 
```
route_quota: { tokens_per_minute: 120000, burst_tokens: 30000, window: "rolling" }
billing_fields: ["input_tokens","output_tokens","tool_calls","embeddings_units"]
```
We can iterate on unit names later.

Josh: Quick Q: do we expose window as rolling vs fixed? Sales customers ask for both. Rolling simplifies UX for bursts but complicates counters. Fixed windows are easier to meter. Which do we pick for MVP?

Maya: For MVP pick fixed-window (1m) so metering and SLAs are simpler. We can add rolling later as an opt-in. Make docs call out known behavioral diff.

Alex: OK. Also need per-route precedence rules: route-level overrides account-level; fallback to account. Add an explicit field for "enforcement_mode": ["hard","soft"] so we can soft-block (quota warnings + sampling) during rollout.

Priya: +1 on enforcement_mode. For pricing alignment, we should surface the token accounting mapping so billing knows which meters feed invoices. Suggest a readable mapping endpoint: GET /billing/mapping returns the names used in the pricing table.

Josh: Another edge: tool/function calling. A single chat request can call multiple tools and return structured output. How do we count tokens for tools — attribute to the originating route or to the tool? Customer request: per-route quota should count all tokens consumed on behalf of that route, including tools. So we must make it explicit.

Maya: Yes. Include field: "include_tool_tokens": true|false on route config. Default true. Also call out that embeddings are billed by embedding-units separately but counted against route quotas if enabled.

Alex: Draft of minimal route schema for product to review (MVP): 
```
{
  "route": "/generate-chat",
  "tokens_per_minute": 120000,
  "burst_tokens": 30000,
  "window_seconds": 60,
  "enforcement_mode": "hard",
  "include_tool_tokens": true,
  "count_embeddings_against_quota": false
}
```
We should include a short human-readable summary for each field in the console.

Priya: Launch criteria we discussed earlier: (1) backend metering with 99.9% accuracy to current accounting infra, (2) docs + SDK examples, (3) billing mapping endpoint + e2e test with finance, (4) can toggle enforcement_mode per-customer. Anything else?

Josh: Add: migration plan for existing routes (we need a default behaviour so existing customers don't see unexpected rejections). Default to very high account quota for legacy tenants until they opt-in.

Maya: Good call. Prioritization: MVP (sprint 1): implement fixed-window quotas, per-route overrides, include_tool_tokens default true, docs + billing mapping. Sprint 2: rolling windows, burst-credit pool shared across routes, soft enforcement, analytics in Console. Sprint 3: rate shapes (separate limits for embeddings vs chat), per-model weight multipliers.

Alex: Can someone pull together a 1-pager for GTM + sales FAQ (how quotas interact with pricing, how function calls counted) by EOD? I can sync with finance.

Priya: I'll draft the 1-pager. Action items: 
- Priya: 1-pager + billing mapping API spec (due EOD)
- Josh: backend metering design and fixed-window counter impl (PR by Thu)
- Alex: coordinate with finance on invoice mapping and naming (sync scheduled)
- Maya: add migration default rules and risk doc for launch

ops-bot: Note added: ticket RN-3245 created for per-route quotas (owner: Josh).

Maya: Thanks everyone — will pull into the roadmap doc and flag dependencies. :thumbsup:
